description: Defines the NoteType enum for different note categories within the Fineract project, including methods for retrieving note type data and mapping from IDs or API URLs.

classes.name: NoteType
classes.description: Enumeration of different note types used in the Fineract system, with associated metadata and utility methods.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the note type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code string for the note type.

methods.name: getApiUrl
methods.description: Returns the API URL string for the note type.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the note type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Retrieves a NoteType based on its integer value.

methods.name: fromApiUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a NoteType based on its API URL string.

methods.name: toEnumOptionData
methods.description: Converts a NoteType or its ID to an EnumOptionData object.

methods.name: toEnumOptionData (instance method)
methods.description: Converts this NoteType instance to an EnumOptionData object.
